    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "COOK THE {{ing_01|CHICKEN}} in this stock: {{ing_02|BROTH}}, {{ing_03|OIL}}, {{ing_04|WINE}}, {{ing_05|A BUNCH OF LEEKS}}, {{ing_06|CORIANDER}}, {{ing_07|SATURY}}; WHEN DONE, CRUSH {{ing_08|PEPPER}}, {{ing_09|NUTS}} with {{ing_10|2 GLASSES OF WATER}} and the {{ing_11|JUICE OF THE CHICKEN}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "RETIRE the {{ing_05|BUNCHES OF GREENS}}, add {{ing_12|MILK}} to taste."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "The things crushed in the mortar add to the {{ing_01|CHICKEN}} and cook it together: THICKEN the sauce with {{ing_13|BEATEN WHITES OF EGG}} and POUR the sauce over the {{ing_01|CHICKEN}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
